F:P.Name: Product
F:P.Description: Financial product types, organized by economic function rather than provider. These are classification concepts, not customer records or statements of ownership. Categories are extensible and do not imply regulatory status or eligibility.

F:P:AC.Name: Account
F:P:AC.Description: Account products for holding deposits, investments or assets. Credit facilities are classified under Credit; tax and retirement wrappers under Retirement.

F:P:AC:BA.Name: Bank account
F:P:AC:BA.Description: Deposit account products. Customer bank details remain at F:BA.

F:P:AC:BA:CU.Name: Current account
F:P:AC:BA:CU.Description: Transaction deposit account, also called a checking account.

F:P:AC:BA:SA.Name: Savings account
F:P:AC:BA:SA.Description: Deposit account primarily intended for saving.

F:P:AC:BA:TD.Name: Term deposit
F:P:AC:BA:TD.Description: Deposit for an agreed term, including non-negotiable certificates of deposit. Negotiable certificates are debt securities.

F:P:AC:BA:MM.Name: Money market deposit account
F:P:AC:BA:MM.Description: Deposit account; distinct from a money market investment fund.

F:P:AC:BR.Name: Brokerage account
F:P:AC:BR.Description: Account used to hold and transact investments; the investments are classified separately.

F:P:AC:CU.Name: Custody account
F:P:AC:CU.Description: Account for safekeeping and administration of assets on behalf of a customer.

F:P:CR.Name: Credit
F:P:CR.Description: Borrowing and financing products, regardless of whether the provider is a bank.

F:P:CR:CA.Name: Credit card
F:P:CR:CA.Description: Card-linked credit facility permitting borrowing for payments. A debit card instead accesses existing funds.

F:P:CR:CH.Name: Charge card
F:P:CR:CH.Description: Card facility generally requiring the statement balance to be paid in full each cycle.

F:P:CR:LN.Name: Loan
F:P:CR:LN.Description: Lending products with contractual repayment obligations. Purpose, collateral, interest basis and lender type are additional characteristics.

F:P:CR:LN:MO.Name: Mortgage loan
F:P:CR:LN:MO.Description: Loan secured by real property, including residential and commercial mortgages; not restricted to bank lenders.

F:P:CR:LN:PE.Name: Personal loan
F:P:CR:LN:PE.Description: Loan for personal use, excluding the more specific mortgage, vehicle and education categories.

F:P:CR:LN:VE.Name: Vehicle loan
F:P:CR:LN:VE.Description: Loan to finance a vehicle purchase.

F:P:CR:LN:ED.Name: Education loan
F:P:CR:LN:ED.Description: Loan to finance education, also called a student loan.

F:P:CR:LN:BU.Name: Business loan
F:P:CR:LN:BU.Description: Loan for business purposes, excluding loans more specifically classified by collateral or structure.

F:P:CR:LN:BN.Name: Buy now, pay later
F:P:CR:LN:BN.Description: Purchase financing with deferred or installment repayments.

F:P:CR:LC.Name: Line of credit
F:P:CR:LC.Description: Facility allowing borrowing up to an agreed limit, including overdrafts, home-equity lines and margin credit. Card facilities have their own categories.

F:P:CR:LE.Name: Finance lease
F:P:CR:LE.Description: Financing arrangement granting use of an asset for payments; distinct from a short-term operating rental.

F:P:CR:TF.Name: Trade and receivables finance
F:P:CR:TF.Description: Products financing trade or receivables, including factoring, invoice finance and letters of credit.

F:P:IN.Name: Investment
F:P:IN.Description: Instruments and pooled investment interests. Classify the instrument separately from the account or wrapper holding it.

F:P:IN:EQ.Name: Equity
F:P:IN:EQ.Description: Ownership interests in an enterprise, including public and private equity.

F:P:IN:EQ:ST.Name: Stock
F:P:IN:EQ:ST.Description: Company shares, also called stocks. Listing venue and public or private status are additional characteristics.

F:P:IN:EQ:ST:PR.Name: Preferred stock
F:P:IN:EQ:ST:PR.Description: Preference shares with specified priority or rights; terms vary by issue.

F:P:IN:EQ:DR.Name: Depositary receipt
F:P:IN:EQ:DR.Description: Receipt representing an interest in underlying shares, including ADRs and GDRs.

F:P:IN:DE.Name: Debt security
F:P:IN:DE.Description: Transferable debt instruments. Direct borrowing facilities belong under Credit.

F:P:IN:DE:BO.Name: Bond
F:P:IN:DE:BO.Description: Bond instruments; issuer sector, security, convertibility and coupon basis are additional characteristics.

F:P:IN:DE:BI.Name: Bill
F:P:IN:DE:BI.Description: Short-term debt security commonly issued at a discount, including treasury bills.

F:P:IN:DE:NO.Name: Note
F:P:IN:DE:NO.Description: Debt notes other than products more specifically classified as structured investments.

F:P:IN:DE:CD.Name: Negotiable certificate of deposit
F:P:IN:DE:CD.Description: Transferable deposit certificate traded as a debt security; non-negotiable term deposits belong under bank accounts.

F:P:IN:DE:AB.Name: Asset-backed security
F:P:IN:DE:AB.Description: Debt security backed by a pool of assets or receivables, including mortgage-backed securities.

F:P:IN:FU.Name: Fund
F:P:IN:FU.Description: Interests in pooled investment vehicles. Strategy, underlying assets and legal form are additional characteristics.

F:P:IN:FU:MF.Name: Mutual fund
F:P:IN:FU:MF.Description: Interests in an open-ended pooled investment fund, excluding exchange-traded funds in this navigation taxonomy.

F:P:IN:FU:ET.Name: Exchange-traded fund
F:P:IN:FU:ET.Description: Fund interests traded on an exchange. Exchange trading does not determine the underlying asset class.

F:P:IN:FU:CE.Name: Closed-end fund
F:P:IN:FU:CE.Description: Interests in a closed-ended investment fund.

F:P:IN:FU:PF.Name: Private fund
F:P:IN:FU:PF.Description: Privately offered pooled investment interests, including private equity, venture capital, private credit and hedge funds.

F:P:IN:DR.Name: Derivative
F:P:IN:DR.Description: Contracts whose value depends on an underlying asset, rate, index or event. Underlier and trading venue are separate characteristics.

F:P:IN:DR:OP.Name: Option
F:P:IN:DR:OP.Description: Contract granting a right, without an obligation, to transact or settle on specified terms.

F:P:IN:DR:FU.Name: Future
F:P:IN:DR:FU.Description: Standardized futures contract for future delivery or settlement.

F:P:IN:DR:FW.Name: Forward
F:P:IN:DR:FW.Description: Bilateral contract for future delivery or settlement on agreed terms.

F:P:IN:DR:SW.Name: Swap
F:P:IN:DR:SW.Description: Contract exchanging cash flows or exposures, including interest-rate, currency and credit-default swaps.

F:P:IN:DR:CF.Name: Contract for difference
F:P:IN:DR:CF.Description: Contract settling differences in the value of an underlying reference.

F:P:IN:DR:WA.Name: Warrant
F:P:IN:DR:WA.Description: Issued instrument granting a right to acquire or dispose of an underlying asset on specified terms.

F:P:IN:ST.Name: Structured investment
F:P:IN:ST.Description: Packaged investments with contractually combined payoffs, such as structured notes and market-linked certificates. Record debt, deposit or derivative legal form separately.

F:P:PA.Name: Payment
F:P:PA.Description: Products providing payment access or stored value. Credit and charge cards are classified under Credit. Customer payment references remain at F:PI.

F:P:PA:DC.Name: Debit card
F:P:PA:DC.Description: Payment card drawing on available account funds; an associated overdraft is a separate credit facility.

F:P:PA:PC.Name: Prepaid card
F:P:PA:PC.Description: Card used to spend prefunded value.

F:P:PA:EM.Name: Electronic money account
F:P:PA:EM.Description: Account holding issued electronic money for payments; not inherently a bank deposit or a cryptoasset.

F:P:IS.Name: Insurance
F:P:IS.Description: Risk coverage contracts. Product types are distinct from customer insurance enquiry records at B:IN.

F:P:IS:LI.Name: Life insurance
F:P:IS:LI.Description: Coverage paying benefits under specified life or death conditions.

F:P:IS:HE.Name: Health insurance
F:P:IS:HE.Description: Coverage of specified healthcare costs or benefits.

F:P:IS:DI.Name: Disability and income protection
F:P:IS:DI.Description: Coverage replacing income or paying benefits for qualifying disability or inability to work.

F:P:IS:PR.Name: Property insurance
F:P:IS:PR.Description: Coverage for loss of or damage to property.

F:P:IS:MO.Name: Motor insurance
F:P:IS:MO.Description: Vehicle-related coverage that may combine property and liability protection.

F:P:IS:TR.Name: Travel insurance
F:P:IS:TR.Description: Travel-related coverage that may combine medical, cancellation and other protections.

F:P:IS:AN.Name: Annuity
F:P:IS:AN.Description: Contract providing payments under specified terms, including lifetime or fixed-period income. Retirement use is an additional characteristic.

F:P:RE.Name: Retirement
F:P:RE.Description: Retirement arrangements and wrappers. Classify underlying funds, stocks, deposits and annuities separately; legal and tax treatment is jurisdiction-specific.

F:P:RE:PE.Name: Pension arrangement
F:P:RE:PE.Description: Retirement benefit arrangement, including defined-benefit and defined-contribution schemes.

F:P:RE:AC.Name: Retirement account
F:P:RE:AC.Description: Individual or employer-sponsored account with retirement-specific rules; local schemes are jurisdictional variants.

F:P:DA.Name: Native digital asset
F:P:DA.Description: Natively digital instruments not better described by another product category. A tokenized share, bond, deposit or fund keeps its economic product classification; tokenization is a representation characteristic.

F:P:DA:CR.Name: Unbacked cryptoasset
F:P:DA:CR.Description: Native cryptoasset without a contractual claim on a reserve asset or issuer, such as bitcoin.

F:P:DA:ST.Name: Stablecoin
F:P:DA:ST.Description: Digital token designed to track a reference value. Reserve structure, redemption rights and legal classification depend on the instrument.

G:AD.Name: Address
G:AD.Description: Address formats and reusable address-use concepts. Choose a country-specific format for an address record; use Roles to constrain the Role relationship.

G:AD:RO.Name: Roles
G:AD:RO.Description: Ways in which an address is used. The terminal concepts are canonical values for address Role fields and can also be referenced by generic tags.

G:AD:RO:RE.Name: Residence
G:AD:RO:RE.Description: Where a person lives. A residence may also be used for billing or shipping; this role describes residential use.

G:AD:RO:OF.Name: Office
G:AD:RO:OF.Description: A place used for work or business operations. It need not be an organization’s legally registered office.

G:AD:RO:RG.Name: Registered office
G:AD:RO:RG.Description: The address designated as an organization’s registered office. Classification does not verify legal registration.

G:AD:RO:SH.Name: Shipping
G:AD:RO:SH.Description: The destination used to deliver goods or shipments.

G:AD:RO:BI.Name: Billing
G:AD:RO:BI.Description: The address associated with billing or invoicing. It can differ from the shipping destination.

G:AD:RO:MA.Name: Mailing
G:AD:RO:MA.Description: The destination used for correspondence, including a postal box when applicable.

G:AD:RO:RT.Name: Returns
G:AD:RO:RT.Description: The destination designated to receive returned goods.

G:AD:RO:PU.Name: Pickup
G:AD:RO:PU.Description: A location where goods or an order can be collected.

G:AD:US.Name: US address
G:AD:US.Description: Address record using the US-style postal layout. The format is distinct from the country concept G:CO:US; migration retains original country information, including non-US addresses entered through the former general form.

B:PRO.Name: Professions
B:PRO.Description: Occupations and trades used to classify people, including contacts, independently of a particular employer or employment record. These concepts do not attest qualifications or current professional status.

B:PRO:LAW.Name: Lawyer
B:PRO:LAW.Description: Provides legal advice or representation, for example a solicitor or attorney. Covers legal practitioners rather than every employee of a law firm.

B:PRO:DOC.Name: Doctor
B:PRO:DOC.Description: Practises human medicine, for example a general practitioner or surgeon. Doctor here means medical practitioner, not an academic doctorate holder; dentists and veterinarians have separate codes.

B:PRO:NUR.Name: Nurse
B:PRO:NUR.Description: Provides nursing care, for example a community or hospital nurse. Distinct from a doctor or a non-nursing care worker.

B:PRO:DEN.Name: Dentist
B:PRO:DEN.Description: Provides dental assessment and treatment, for example a general dentist. Distinct from a dental assistant or medical doctor.

B:PRO:PHA.Name: Pharmacist
B:PRO:PHA.Description: Works in medicines dispensing or pharmacy practice, for example a community pharmacist. Distinct from a pharmacy retail assistant.

B:PRO:PHY.Name: Physiotherapist
B:PRO:PHY.Description: Provides physical rehabilitation and movement therapy, for example rehabilitation after an injury. Also called a physical therapist; distinct from a fitness trainer.

B:PRO:PSY.Name: Psychologist
B:PRO:PSY.Description: Works in psychological assessment, research or interventions, for example a clinical psychologist. Distinct from a psychiatrist, who is a medical doctor.

B:PRO:VET.Name: Veterinarian
B:PRO:VET.Description: Provides medical care for animals, for example a companion-animal vet. Distinct from a human medical doctor or animal groomer.

B:PRO:ACC.Name: Accountant
B:PRO:ACC.Description: Prepares, examines or advises on financial accounts, for example a tax accountant. Distinct from a financial adviser recommending financial plans.

B:PRO:FAD.Name: Financial adviser
B:PRO:FAD.Description: Advises on financial planning and financial decisions, for example retirement planning. Distinct from accounting or merely selling a financial product.

B:PRO:INS.Name: Insurance broker
B:PRO:INS.Description: Arranges insurance cover for clients, for example a commercial insurance broker. Describes the person’s work, not an insurance policy or product.

B:PRO:REA.Name: Real estate agent
B:PRO:REA.Description: Helps clients buy, sell or lease property, for example a residential estate agent. Distinct from an architect or building contractor.

B:PRO:ENG.Name: Engineer
B:PRO:ENG.Description: Designs, develops or evaluates engineered systems, for example a civil or mechanical engineer. Software developers have a separate code; both can apply when relevant.

B:PRO:ARC.Name: Architect
B:PRO:ARC.Description: Designs buildings and their spatial organization, for example a residential architect. Does not mean a software architect or every building designer.

B:PRO:DEV.Name: Software developer
B:PRO:DEV.Description: Creates and maintains software, for example an application programmer or software engineer. Distinct from general IT support.

B:PRO:ITS.Name: IT specialist
B:PRO:ITS.Description: Supports or administers computing systems, networks or security, for example a systems administrator. Software development is classified separately when that is the work being described.

B:PRO:SCI.Name: Scientist
B:PRO:SCI.Description: Conducts scientific research, for example a laboratory biologist or physicist. Distinct from a teacher whose primary work is teaching science.

B:PRO:TEA.Name: Teacher
B:PRO:TEA.Description: Teaches learners in an educational setting, for example a school teacher or private tutor. University lecturers have a separate code.

B:PRO:LEC.Name: Lecturer
B:PRO:LEC.Description: Teaches in higher education, for example a university lecturer or teaching professor. Research work may additionally be classified as Scientist.

B:PRO:DES.Name: Designer
B:PRO:DES.Description: Creates visual, digital or product designs, for example a graphic or interaction designer. Building architecture has a separate code.

B:PRO:ART.Name: Artist
B:PRO:ART.Description: Creates works of art, for example a painter or sculptor. Photography, music and design have separate codes where those better describe the work.

B:PRO:WRI.Name: Writer
B:PRO:WRI.Description: Creates written works, for example a novelist or copywriter. Journalists have a separate code for news reporting.

B:PRO:JOU.Name: Journalist
B:PRO:JOU.Description: Researches and reports news, for example a newspaper reporter. Distinct from other writing such as fiction or advertising copy.

B:PRO:PHO.Name: Photographer
B:PRO:PHO.Description: Creates photographs professionally, for example a portrait photographer. Does not classify someone merely because they take personal photographs.

B:PRO:MUS.Name: Musician
B:PRO:MUS.Description: Performs or creates music, for example a pianist or composer. Music teaching can additionally use Teacher.

B:PRO:ELE.Name: Electrician
B:PRO:ELE.Description: Installs, maintains or repairs electrical wiring and equipment, for example domestic wiring. Distinct from electrical engineering design.

B:PRO:PLU.Name: Plumber
B:PRO:PLU.Description: Installs, maintains or repairs water, drainage and related pipe systems, for example domestic plumbing. Distinct from general building work.

B:PRO:CAR.Name: Carpenter
B:PRO:CAR.Description: Builds, installs or repairs wooden structures and fittings, for example cabinetry or framing. Distinct from general building contracting.

B:PRO:BLD.Name: Builder
B:PRO:BLD.Description: Carries out or coordinates building construction, for example a residential building contractor. Specialized trades can use their own codes.

B:PRO:MEC.Name: Mechanic
B:PRO:MEC.Description: Maintains and repairs vehicles or machinery, for example an automotive mechanic. Distinct from engineering design.

B:PRO:CHE.Name: Chef
B:PRO:CHE.Description: Prepares food professionally, for example a restaurant chef or cook. Distinct from a restaurant owner whose work is management.

B:PRO:HAI.Name: Hairdresser
B:PRO:HAI.Description: Cuts, styles or treats hair, for example a salon stylist or barber. Distinct from other beauty services.

B:PRO:FIT.Name: Fitness trainer
B:PRO:FIT.Description: Guides exercise and physical conditioning, for example a personal trainer. Distinct from physiotherapy rehabilitation.

B:PRO:TRA.Name: Translator
B:PRO:TRA.Description: Converts written content between languages, for example a document translator. Spoken or signed interpretation has a separate code.

B:PRO:INT.Name: Interpreter
B:PRO:INT.Description: Converts spoken or signed communication between languages, for example a conference interpreter. Distinct from written translation.

B:PRO:SOC.Name: Social worker
B:PRO:SOC.Description: Supports people with social needs and access to services, for example a family social worker. Distinct from clinical psychology or nursing.

F:P.Description: Financial product types, organized by economic function rather than provider. These are classification concepts, not customer records or statements of ownership. Categories are extensible and do not imply regulatory status or eligibility.

F:P:AC.Name: Account
F:P:AC.Description: Account products for holding deposits, investments or assets. Credit facilities are classified under Credit; tax and retirement wrappers under Retirement.

F:P:AC:BA.Name: Bank account
F:P:AC:BA.Description: Deposit account products. Customer bank details remain at F:BA.

F:P:AC:BA:CU.Name: Current account
F:P:AC:BA:CU.Description: Transaction deposit account, also called a checking account.

F:P:AC:BA:SA.Name: Savings account
F:P:AC:BA:SA.Description: Deposit account primarily intended for saving.

F:P:AC:BA:TD.Name: Term deposit
F:P:AC:BA:TD.Description: Deposit for an agreed term, including non-negotiable certificates of deposit. Negotiable certificates are debt securities.

F:P:AC:BA:MM.Name: Money market deposit account
F:P:AC:BA:MM.Description: Deposit account; distinct from a money market investment fund.

F:P:AC:BR.Name: Brokerage account
F:P:AC:BR.Description: Account used to hold and transact investments; the investments are classified separately.

F:P:AC:CU.Name: Custody account
F:P:AC:CU.Description: Account for safekeeping and administration of assets on behalf of a customer.

F:P:CR.Name: Credit
F:P:CR.Description: Borrowing and financing products, regardless of whether the provider is a bank.

F:P:CR:CA.Name: Credit card
F:P:CR:CA.Description: Card-linked credit facility permitting borrowing for payments. A debit card instead accesses existing funds.

F:P:CR:CH.Name: Charge card
F:P:CR:CH.Description: Card facility generally requiring the statement balance to be paid in full each cycle.

F:P:CR:LN.Name: Loan
F:P:CR:LN.Description: Lending products with contractual repayment obligations. Purpose, collateral, interest basis and lender type are additional characteristics.

F:P:CR:LN:MO.Name: Mortgage loan
F:P:CR:LN:MO.Description: Loan secured by real property, including residential and commercial mortgages; not restricted to bank lenders.

F:P:CR:LN:PE.Name: Personal loan
F:P:CR:LN:PE.Description: Loan for personal use, excluding the more specific mortgage, vehicle and education categories.

F:P:CR:LN:VE.Name: Vehicle loan
F:P:CR:LN:VE.Description: Loan to finance a vehicle purchase.

F:P:CR:LN:ED.Name: Education loan
F:P:CR:LN:ED.Description: Loan to finance education, also called a student loan.

F:P:CR:LN:BU.Name: Business loan
F:P:CR:LN:BU.Description: Loan for business purposes, excluding loans more specifically classified by collateral or structure.

F:P:CR:LN:BN.Name: Buy now, pay later
F:P:CR:LN:BN.Description: Purchase financing with deferred or installment repayments.

F:P:CR:LC.Name: Line of credit
F:P:CR:LC.Description: Facility allowing borrowing up to an agreed limit, including overdrafts, home-equity lines and margin credit. Card facilities have their own categories.

F:P:CR:LE.Name: Finance lease
F:P:CR:LE.Description: Financing arrangement granting use of an asset for payments; distinct from a short-term operating rental.

F:P:CR:TF.Name: Trade and receivables finance
F:P:CR:TF.Description: Products financing trade or receivables, including factoring, invoice finance and letters of credit.

F:P:IN.Name: Investment
F:P:IN.Description: Instruments and pooled investment interests. Classify the instrument separately from the account or wrapper holding it.

F:P:IN:EQ.Name: Equity
F:P:IN:EQ.Description: Ownership interests in an enterprise, including public and private equity.

F:P:IN:EQ:ST.Name: Stock
F:P:IN:EQ:ST.Description: Company shares, also called stocks. Listing venue and public or private status are additional characteristics.

F:P:IN:EQ:ST:PR.Name: Preferred stock
F:P:IN:EQ:ST:PR.Description: Preference shares with specified priority or rights; terms vary by issue.

F:P:IN:EQ:DR.Name: Depositary receipt
F:P:IN:EQ:DR.Description: Receipt representing an interest in underlying shares, including ADRs and GDRs.

F:P:IN:DE.Name: Debt security
F:P:IN:DE.Description: Transferable debt instruments. Direct borrowing facilities belong under Credit.

F:P:IN:DE:BO.Name: Bond
F:P:IN:DE:BO.Description: Bond instruments; issuer sector, security, convertibility and coupon basis are additional characteristics.

F:P:IN:DE:BI.Name: Bill
F:P:IN:DE:BI.Description: Short-term debt security commonly issued at a discount, including treasury bills.

F:P:IN:DE:NO.Name: Note
F:P:IN:DE:NO.Description: Debt notes other than products more specifically classified as structured investments.

F:P:IN:DE:CD.Name: Negotiable certificate of deposit
F:P:IN:DE:CD.Description: Transferable deposit certificate traded as a debt security; non-negotiable term deposits belong under bank accounts.

F:P:IN:DE:AB.Name: Asset-backed security
F:P:IN:DE:AB.Description: Debt security backed by a pool of assets or receivables, including mortgage-backed securities.

F:P:IN:FU.Name: Fund
F:P:IN:FU.Description: Interests in pooled investment vehicles. Strategy, underlying assets and legal form are additional characteristics.

F:P:IN:FU:MF.Name: Mutual fund
F:P:IN:FU:MF.Description: Interests in an open-ended pooled investment fund, excluding exchange-traded funds in this navigation taxonomy.

F:P:IN:FU:ET.Name: Exchange-traded fund
F:P:IN:FU:ET.Description: Fund interests traded on an exchange. Exchange trading does not determine the underlying asset class.

F:P:IN:FU:CE.Name: Closed-end fund
F:P:IN:FU:CE.Description: Interests in a closed-ended investment fund.

F:P:IN:FU:PF.Name: Private fund
F:P:IN:FU:PF.Description: Privately offered pooled investment interests, including private equity, venture capital, private credit and hedge funds.

F:P:IN:DR.Name: Derivative
F:P:IN:DR.Description: Contracts whose value depends on an underlying asset, rate, index or event. Underlier and trading venue are separate characteristics.

F:P:IN:DR:OP.Name: Option
F:P:IN:DR:OP.Description: Contract granting a right, without an obligation, to transact or settle on specified terms.

F:P:IN:DR:FU.Name: Future
F:P:IN:DR:FU.Description: Standardized futures contract for future delivery or settlement.

F:P:IN:DR:FW.Name: Forward
F:P:IN:DR:FW.Description: Bilateral contract for future delivery or settlement on agreed terms.

F:P:IN:DR:SW.Name: Swap
F:P:IN:DR:SW.Description: Contract exchanging cash flows or exposures, including interest-rate, currency and credit-default swaps.

F:P:IN:DR:CF.Name: Contract for difference
F:P:IN:DR:CF.Description: Contract settling differences in the value of an underlying reference.

F:P:IN:DR:WA.Name: Warrant
F:P:IN:DR:WA.Description: Issued instrument granting a right to acquire or dispose of an underlying asset on specified terms.

F:P:IN:ST.Name: Structured investment
F:P:IN:ST.Description: Packaged investments with contractually combined payoffs, such as structured notes and market-linked certificates. Record debt, deposit or derivative legal form separately.

F:P:PA.Name: Payment
F:P:PA.Description: Products providing payment access or stored value. Credit and charge cards are classified under Credit. Customer payment references remain at F:PI.

F:P:PA:DC.Name: Debit card
F:P:PA:DC.Description: Payment card drawing on available account funds; an associated overdraft is a separate credit facility.

F:P:PA:PC.Name: Prepaid card
F:P:PA:PC.Description: Card used to spend prefunded value.

F:P:PA:EM.Name: Electronic money account
F:P:PA:EM.Description: Account holding issued electronic money for payments; not inherently a bank deposit or a cryptoasset.

F:P:IS.Name: Insurance
F:P:IS.Description: Risk coverage contracts. Product types are distinct from customer insurance enquiry records at B:IN.

F:P:IS:LI.Name: Life insurance
F:P:IS:LI.Description: Coverage paying benefits under specified life or death conditions.

F:P:IS:HE.Name: Health insurance
F:P:IS:HE.Description: Coverage of specified healthcare costs or benefits.

F:P:IS:DI.Name: Disability and income protection
F:P:IS:DI.Description: Coverage replacing income or paying benefits for qualifying disability or inability to work.

F:P:IS:PR.Name: Property insurance
F:P:IS:PR.Description: Coverage for loss of or damage to property.

F:P:IS:MO.Name: Motor insurance
F:P:IS:MO.Description: Vehicle-related coverage that may combine property and liability protection.

F:P:IS:TR.Name: Travel insurance
F:P:IS:TR.Description: Travel-related coverage that may combine medical, cancellation and other protections.

F:P:IS:AN.Name: Annuity
F:P:IS:AN.Description: Contract providing payments under specified terms, including lifetime or fixed-period income. Retirement use is an additional characteristic.

F:P:RE.Name: Retirement
F:P:RE.Description: Retirement arrangements and wrappers. Classify underlying funds, stocks, deposits and annuities separately; legal and tax treatment is jurisdiction-specific.

F:P:RE:PE.Name: Pension arrangement
F:P:RE:PE.Description: Retirement benefit arrangement, including defined-benefit and defined-contribution schemes.

F:P:RE:AC.Name: Retirement account
F:P:RE:AC.Description: Individual or employer-sponsored account with retirement-specific rules; local schemes are jurisdictional variants.

F:P:DA.Name: Native digital asset
F:P:DA.Description: Natively digital instruments not better described by another product category. A tokenized share, bond, deposit or fund keeps its economic product classification; tokenization is a representation characteristic.

F:P:DA:CR.Name: Unbacked cryptoasset
F:P:DA:CR.Description: Native cryptoasset without a contractual claim on a reserve asset or issuer, such as bitcoin.

F:P:DA:ST.Name: Stablecoin
F:P:DA:ST.Description: Digital token designed to track a reference value. Reserve structure, redemption rights and legal classification depend on the instrument.

G:AD.Name: Address
G:AD.Description: Address formats and reusable address-use concepts. Choose a country-specific format for an address record; use Roles to constrain the Role relationship.

G:AD:RO.Name: Roles
G:AD:RO.Description: Ways in which an address is used. The terminal concepts are canonical values for address Role fields and can also be referenced by generic tags.

G:AD:RO:RE.Name: Residence
G:AD:RO:RE.Description: Where a person lives. A residence may also be used for billing or shipping; this role describes residential use.

G:AD:RO:OF.Name: Office
G:AD:RO:OF.Description: A place used for work or business operations. It need not be an organization’s legally registered office.

G:AD:RO:RG.Name: Registered office
G:AD:RO:RG.Description: The address designated as an organization’s registered office. Classification does not verify legal registration.

G:AD:RO:SH.Name: Shipping
G:AD:RO:SH.Description: The destination used to deliver goods or shipments.

G:AD:RO:BI.Name: Billing
G:AD:RO:BI.Description: The address associated with billing or invoicing. It can differ from the shipping destination.

G:AD:RO:MA.Name: Mailing
G:AD:RO:MA.Description: The destination used for correspondence, including a postal box when applicable.

G:AD:RO:RT.Name: Returns
G:AD:RO:RT.Description: The destination designated to receive returned goods.

G:AD:RO:PU.Name: Pickup
G:AD:RO:PU.Description: A location where goods or an order can be collected.

G:AD:US.Name: US address
G:AD:US.Description: Address record using the US-style postal layout. The format is distinct from the country concept G:CO:US; migration retains original country information, including non-US addresses entered through the former general form.

G:AD:US:R.Name: Role
G:AD:US:R.Question: What is the role of this address?
G:AD:US:R.Description: Reference one terminal address-use concept under Geography:Address:Roles. Store its canonical code, not its display label.

G:AD:US:L1.Name: Address line 1
G:AD:US:L1.Question: What is the first address line?

G:AD:US:L2.Name: Address line 2
G:AD:US:L2.Question: What is the second address line?

G:AD:US:C.Name: City
G:AD:US:C.Question: What is the city or locality?

G:AD:US:RE.Name: Region
G:AD:US:RE.Question: What is the state, province, or region?

G:AD:US:CO.Name: Country
G:AD:US:CO.Question: What is the country?
G:AD:US:CO.Description: Country or territory dataset identifier. Historic G:CO:XX values remain stable data IDs.

G:AD:US:DI.Name: Delivery instructions
G:AD:US:DI.Question: What instructions should a delivery service follow?

G:CO.Name: Country
G:CO.Description: A country or territory used as a geographic location or jurisdiction. Named places and ISO identifiers are reference data; inclusion does not adjudicate sovereignty.

G:SD.Name: Subdivision
G:SD.Description: A named administrative or constituent part of a country, such as a state or province. Named subdivisions and their identifiers are reference data, not child definitions.

H:AL:S.Name: Substance
H:AL:S.Question: Which substance does this record concern?

H:AL:ST.Name: Status
H:AL:ST.Question: What is your reported allergy status for this substance?

H:AL:R.Name: Reaction
H:AL:R.Question: What reaction have you experienced, if any?

H:AL:N.Name: Notes
H:AL:N.Question: What additional information would you like to provide?

H:MED:D.Name: Dose
H:MED:D.Question: What dose do you take, including units?

H:MED:F.Name: Frequency
H:MED:F.Question: How often do you take it?

H:HX:C.Name: Condition
H:HX:C.Question: What condition would you like to record?

H:HX:D.Name: Diagnosis date
H:HX:D.Question: When was this condition diagnosed, if known?

H:HX:N.Name: Notes
H:HX:N.Question: What else should a practitioner know about this condition?

H:AC:N.Name: Need
H:AC:N.Question: What accessibility accommodation do you need?

H:D:P:I.Name: Food or ingredient
H:D:P:I.Question: Which food, ingredient, or cuisine does this concern?

H:D:D:N.Name: Restriction
H:D:D:N.Question: What dietary restriction should a provider observe?

H:D:D:I.Name: Instructions
H:D:D:I.Question: What preparation instructions should a provider follow?

B:IN:T.Name: Policy type
B:IN:T.Question: What type of insurance is this?

B:C:M.Name: Merchant
B:C:M.Description: A person or organization acting as a seller. Membership in a directory does not attest legal identity.

B:C:ML.Name: Merchant list
B:C:ML.Description: A directory or owner-maintained collection of merchant references.

B:C:O.Name: Offer
B:C:O.Description: A merchant proposal to supply goods or services; separate from the underlying product.

B:C:OR.Name: Order
B:C:OR.Description: An order for goods or services.

B:C:OL.Name: Order line
B:C:OL.Description: One line of an order or checkout.

B:C:CK.Name: Checkout
B:C:CK.Description: A checkout session and its proposed transaction.

B:C:FU.Name: Fulfillment
B:C:FU.Description: Delivery or fulfillment of an order.

B:C:SI.Name: Sale intent
B:C:SI.Description: A proposed sale and its satisfaction conditions.

B:C:OA.Name: Offer response
B:C:OA.Description: Acceptance or decline of an offer by a user.

B:C:ME.Name: Merchant enrollment
B:C:ME.Description: Enrollment of a merchant in a project or program.

B:C:CP.Name: Customer profile
B:C:CP.Description: Customer information maintained for a commerce relationship.

B:C:SU.Name: Support request
B:C:SU.Description: An inquiry or request for support.

B:C:NS.Name: Newsletter subscription
B:C:NS.Description: Consent and delivery details for a newsletter.

B:C:RC.Name: Recruiter
B:C:RC.Description: A recruiter participating in merchant acquisition.

B:C:RA.Name: Recruiter assignment
B:C:RA.Description: Assignment of a merchant to a recruiter.

B:C:MN.Name: Menu
B:C:MN.Description: An ordered collection of products offered by a merchant.

B:C:MT.Name: Merchant category
B:C:MT.Description: A classification of merchant business activity.

B:C:PM.Name: Purchase mandate
B:C:PM.Description: Delegated purchase authority. Classification does not grant authority.

B:C:MU.Name: Mandate use
B:C:MU.Description: A recorded exercise of delegated purchase authority.

B:C:MR.Name: Mandate reservation
B:C:MR.Description: A reservation against a purchase mandate.

B:C:OE.Name: Order event
B:C:OE.Description: An event in an order lifecycle.

B:PRO.Name: Profession
B:PRO.Description: An occupation or skilled trade practiced by a person. This describes work, not a particular employer or proof of qualifications. Named professions are reference data.

S:T:SV.Name: Service
S:T:SV.Description: An online service through which a person or organization has an account or can be contacted. Named providers and their presentation rules are reference data.

S:I:D:T:ID.Name: Identifier
S:I:D:T:ID.Description: Text preserves leading zeros. Pair external identifiers with a scheme and issuer.

S:I:D:OP:CFG.Name: Application configuration
S:I:D:OP:CFG.Description: Internal operational data; classification does not make it shareable.

S:I:D:OP:EV.Name: Processed event
S:I:D:OP:EV.Description: Internal operational data; classification does not make it shareable.

S:I:D:OP:AU.Name: Authentication challenge
S:I:D:OP:AU.Description: Internal operational data; classification does not make it shareable.

S:I:D:OP:ID.Name: Idempotency record
S:I:D:OP:ID.Description: Internal operational data; classification does not make it shareable.

S:I:D:OP:JOB.Name: Background job
S:I:D:OP:JOB.Description: Internal operational data; classification does not make it shareable.

S:I:D:OP:WH.Name: Webhook endpoint
S:I:D:OP:WH.Description: Internal operational data; classification does not make it shareable.

S:I:D:OP:WD.Name: Webhook delivery
S:I:D:OP:WD.Description: Internal operational data; classification does not make it shareable.

S:I:D:OP:CUR.Name: Processing cursor
S:I:D:OP:CUR.Description: Internal operational data; classification does not make it shareable.

S:I:D:OP:MSG.Name: Outbound message
S:I:D:OP:MSG.Description: Internal operational data; classification does not make it shareable.
